integrity: A complete proof and executable reproducibility checks are supplied. No independent review or certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The individual polar volume is Euclidean in the canonical sum-zero metric, not invariant under arbitrary affine changes of simplex.
The volume product uses the barycenter as the unique Santaló point by symmetry.
Finite exact and floating-point checks corroborate, but do not substitute for, the all-dimensional proof.
Historical priority awaits independent review; unindexed weighted-root-polytope or older dual-volume results might overlap.
title: Exact polar volumes of ratio-bounded simplex central polytopes
